text:
📍 Santamaría Bullring, Bogotá, Colombia 🇨🇴 

Built in 1931, this striking Moorish-style arena is one of Bogotá’s best-known historic landmarks. 

Its red-brick façade and horseshoe arches stand out in the city. 

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Bogota #Colombia

📍 Mann Island & Port of Liverpool, England 🇬🇧

Black-clad Mann Island buildings meet the grand 1907 Port of Liverpool Building along the Mersey.

Together, they create one of Liverpool’s most striking waterfront views.

Would you explore it?
#Travel #TravelPhotography #Liverpool #England

📍 Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge 🇭🇰🇨🇳🇲🇴 

Famous for its huge scale: 55 km of bridges, tunnels and artificial islands connect Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macau. 

Opened in 2018, it crosses the Pearl River estuary. 

Would you drive across it?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #China #HongKong

📍 Fjaðrárgljúfur Canyon, Iceland 🇮🇸

Moss-covered cliffs rise above a winding river in this dramatic canyon, carved by water over thousands of years. 

Its twisting shape makes every viewpoint look different.

Would you hike through it?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Iceland #Fjadrargljufur

📍 Azat Reservoir, Armenia 🇦🇲

 Nestled below the Yeranos Mountains, its deep blue water contrasts with the rugged landscape. 

The reservoir lies near the famous Khosrov Forest and Mount Ararat can be seen from nearby viewpoints. 

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Armenia #Azat

📍 Toronto skyline, Canada 🇨🇦

 Dominated by the iconic CN Tower, once the world’s tallest free-standing structure.

Rising 553m above the city, it still defines Toronto’s skyline.

At sunset, the tower seems to glow above the rooftops.

Would you visit?
#Travel #TravelPhotography #Toronto #Canada

📍 Tegallalang Rice Terraces, Bali 🇮🇩

Famous for lush green rice fields carved into steep hillsides.

Farmers use subak irrigation, a system shaped by Balinese culture for centuries. 

The layered terraces look incredible from above.

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Bali #Indonesia

📍 Place de la Bourse, Bordeaux, France 🇫🇷 

Its grand 18th-century façades reflect in the Miroir d’eau, the world’s largest reflecting pool. 

When the water turns to mist, the square takes on a completely different look. 

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Bordeaux #France

📍 Manhattan Bridge, Brooklyn, NYC 🇺🇸 

Framed by red-brick buildings on Washington Street, its steel towers create one of New York’s most recognizable views. 

The Empire State Building appears perfectly between the arches. 

Would you take this photo?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #NYC #Brooklyn

📍 Èze, French Riviera, France 🇫🇷 

Famous for its medieval lanes perched high above the Mediterranean. 

Stone houses, narrow passages and sea views fill the old village, while the exotic garden crowns the hilltop.

Would you wander these streets?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #France #Eze

📍 Taipei, Taiwan 🇹🇼 

Highways weave through the city beside the river, with Taipei’s mountains rising beyond. 

It’s a striking mix of dense urban life, water and green hills, all in one view.

 Would you explore Taipei this way?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Taipei #Taiwan
